name: vibeforge
description: Local AI Creative Session Studio - minimal working version

scripts.nuke:data: node -e "const p=require('path').join(process.env.APPDATA,'VibeForge'); const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync(p)){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Nuked:',p);}else{console.log('No data dir at',p);}"
scripts.verify:clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const Database=require('better-sqlite3'); const p=require('path').join(process.env.APPDATA,'VibeForge','data','vibeforge.db'); const db=fs.existsSync(p)?new Database(p):null; const c=t=>db?db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM '+t).get().c:0; console.log('projects:',c('projects'),'sessions:',c('sessions'),'decisions:',c('decisions'),'tasks:',c('tasks'),'ideas:',c('ideas')); if(db)db.close();"
